adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath` now does `type.replace('_', '-')` before checking `ADMIN_MODELS`. In JS this only replaces the first underscore, so it’s a brittle normalization approach if a model type ever contains multiple underscores (e.g. `foo_bar_baz` would become `foo-bar_baz`). In this diff it likely works for the current entries (`site_customization`, `embeddable_host` each have one underscore), so it’s not a proven bug, but it is a valid maintainability/architecture concern introduced into a shared adapter.
